narrative.intro: Csi Aviation has $278M in contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Csi Aviation has 1 award this fiscal year, with an average award size of $278M. Obligations fell 78.4% year over year. Csi Aviation obligations rose from $4.8M in FY22 to $162M in FY23, $350M in FY24, $661M in FY25, and $1.3B in FY26 before declining to $278M in FY27. The current-year totals are partial because FY2027 is fiscal year to date. The page reports contract obligations rather than award-value totals except where award values are noted in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables.
